tab1.text1:
Welcome to <RichColor Color="1,0.2,0.6,1">Matriark</> - a <RichColor Color="0,0.6,1,1">Community of Mature Survivors</>.

This is a stable, long-term 9 map cluster with crossplay-safe mods and plugins that enhance gameplay for Adult Players.

The founder, <RichColor Color="1,0.2,0.6,1">JustSimply_JJ</>, has hosted Ark maps since 2021 and self-hosts Matriark solo
<RichColor Color="0,1,0,1">- she keeps the servers maintained, updated, and running well.</>

Many of the players you’ll meet here have been part of this Community for a long time.

<RichColor Color="1,1,0,1">On Matriark you can explore, build, and survive with like-minded adults who value respect, consideration, and zero toxicity.</>

<RichColor Color="1,0.3,0.7,1">We hope you enjoy your time with us.</>
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
<RichColor Color="1,0.5,0.2,1">Happy Arking! <3</>

tab2.text1:
<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">1.</> Be a respectful adult, no exceptions - no toxicity, harassment, or drama anywhere on the Cluster.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">2.</> Character, tames & Tribe names - no inappropriate names or human character names (any language), final call is JJ's.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">3.</> No replacements or handouts from normal gameplay - if bug or glitch, it may be reviewed via a help ticket only.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">4.</> No repeated complaints in any chat, it's disruptive. Most issues to be resolved via Wildcard or mod updates.
 Check your mod list for out of date or invalid mods to fix client side issues.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">5.</> Build & base limits - do not build close to other player or public structures.
 Base limits per tribe per map:
 1 main base
 1 outpost, public trap or treehouse
 1 water pen - to store and breed water tames

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">6.</> Do not leave tames on breed or wander, only exception: 2 snails + 2 dung beetles if caged & neutered.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">7.</> Fair Trades & Breeding - Only un-mutated dinos may be traded, gifted, or bred with another Tribe.
 - All trades must be fair and balanced.
 - When applicable, trades should use in-game shop points and/or resources—no freebies that bypass progression.

<RichColor color="0,1,1,1">8.</> Do not block major resources, explorer notes, artifact caves, or public-use areas.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">9.</> Max 30 tames out while offline - no tames on neutral, aggressive, or flee. All tames must remain at your base.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">10.</> Turret settings - set to wilds only, medium or low range.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">11.</> Structure pickup is ON - clean up after yourself, no spamming for any reason.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">12.</> Cloning chambers - max 1 per Tribe, per map.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">13.</> Choose Tribe members wisely, repeated rule violations may result in full tribe wipe/ban.

<RichColor Color="0,1,1,1">14.</> Turn off crafting, automation and breeding stations before extended log-off.
 Help keep the maps running smoothly for players online.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>

tab4.text1:
Quick Tips

Important Tribe Enforcer Info:
Tribe is auto created on join and synced across all maps. The Owner should rename the tribe then travel to all maps one time before inviting members.

Awesome teleporters act as teleporter and transmitter.

Tames keep their inventory in SCS cryopods, allows easy transfer of element and boss items between maps.

Plugins prevent stealing and griefing; unlock storage box for player trades.

The Matriark in-game shop is accessed via the radial menu and offers starter kits, potions, tames, and resources. Loonies are earned by playing only.

The Shiny! tracker is disabled. All Shiny! dinos are level 210 - use der dino finder via your inventory map tab to help locate them.

Lethal Decay is active, all structure tiers are 21 days & tames 14 days before decay.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
tab4.text2:
Companion Whistle Dump (Workaround)

Step 1: Empty your entire inventory into storage (gear, cosmetics, hotbar — leave only the whistles)

Step 2: Travel to Aberration and spawn at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 3: Pull your implant (R2 on the implant)

Step 4: Respawn again at the Matriark Hub spawn point.

Step 5: Use the Awesome Teleporter or Transmitter to return to previous map.
<RichColor Color="0.5,0.5,0.5,1">────────────</>
